asphalt
-------
## Purpose
Modern Roblox asset-sync tool with Open Cloud, Studio/debug targets, and Luau/TypeScript code generation

## Tool
family:   Asset pipeline
kind:     rokit tool
provider: jacktabscode/asphalt
status:   actively maintained

## Official documentation
https://github.com/jackTabsCode/asphalt

## When useful
When your project has images, audio, videos, animations or models and you want a maintained replacement for hand-managed asset IDs.

## Usage steps
  asphalt sync studio           Sync assets locally to Roblox Studio for testing.
  asphalt sync cloud --dry-run  Check what would upload without changing Roblox assets.
  asphalt sync                  Upload changed assets to Roblox and write asphalt.lock.toml.
  asphalt migrate-lockfile      Update an existing lockfile to the newest Asphalt format.

## Caveats
  - Configured by asphalt.toml in the project root. `rproj setup asphalt` writes a starter config, but you must replace creator.id before cloud sync.
  - Cloud sync needs an Open Cloud API key via --api-key or ASPHALT_API_KEY with asset:read and asset:write permissions.
  - Generated code formatting is not a stable API; keep the generated file small and review lint/format ignores if your gate starts checking it.

## Purpose
Atom-based state management, inspired by Jotai/Nanostores

## When useful
Share small reactive state without a central reducer.

## Requirements / placement
Shared ModuleScript; server and client state are separate.

Wally imports use the generated aliases below. Select: charm.

Select Wally to install these dependencies. No-manager projects do not install packages.

## Example
local Charm = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").packages.charm)
local count = Charm.atom(0)
local stop = Charm.effect(function() print(count()) end)
count(1)
stop()

## Caveats
Use immutable updates for tables. Dispose effects; sharing a module does not replicate its state.

## Package

https://github.com/littensy/charm

details.charmSync:
charmSync
---------
## Purpose
Client/server atom synchronization for Charm

## When useful
Connect Charm state to your client/server transport.

## Requirements / placement
Client setup snippet; select charm too.

Wally imports use the generated aliases below. Select: charm, charmSync.

Select Wally to install these dependencies. No-manager projects do not install packages.

## Example
local Charm = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").packages.charm)
local CharmSync = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").packages.charmSync)
local coins = Charm.atom(0)
CharmSync.client.addSignals({ coins = coins })
-- Later, during teardown:
CharmSync.client.removeSignals("coins")

## Caveats
Registration alone sends nothing. Wire server.addSignalsToClient, server.connect, and client.sync through your remotes; validate client requests server-side.

wally

## Purpose
Package manager for Roblox/Luau, similar to npm or cargo

## Tool
family:   Wally
kind:     rokit tool
provider: wally
status:   actively maintained

## Official documentation
https://wally.run/

## When useful
Whenever you want a third-party library and you picked the Wally workflow.

## Usage steps
  wally install         Install everything in wally.toml. Run after cloning, or after editing dependencies.
  wally update          Re-resolve to newer allowed versions and update wally.lock.
  wally search <query>  Find packages in the registry.

## Caveats
  - Commit wally.lock (like Cargo.lock) so everyone resolves identical versions.
  - Packages/ is generated - it's gitignored and rebuilt by `wally install`.
  - Every install rewrites Packages/ *without* type information, so a plain `wally install` silently turns all your package types back into `any`. Follow it with wally-package-types - or just use `rproj watch`, which does both.

https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/wally-package-types
